_comment: All providers speak the OpenAI chat-completions protocol. API keys are read from the environment variable named in api_key_env - never put a key in this file. Prices are USD per 1M tokens and are only used to ESTIMATE spend; check the provider's pricing page and edit. Model names change often: run `python generate.py --list-models <provider>` to see what your key can use, then edit `model`.

openai.terms_note: OpenAI usage policies restrict using outputs to develop models that compete with OpenAI. Read before scaling; tag kept so these puzzles can be dropped.

deepseek.terms_note: DeepSeek model weights are MIT; API terms permissive. Preferred source for scale-up.

openrouter_gptoss.terms_note: Apache-2.0 open-weight model; what NVARC used for ~all of its puzzles.

gemini.terms_note: AI Studio free tier is rate-limited; Google terms restrict training competing models. Read before scaling.

mock.terms_note: Offline test provider; returns a canned puzzle.
